chapter_title: Concerning the Five Releases: what they are
chapter_note: This chapter is largely a systematic five-fold cosmological enumeration of “releases/savings” (First Man → Living Spirit → Third Ambassador → Jesus the Splendour → Great Counsel/Summons-and-Obedience), a classic substrate pattern. A brief hagiographic dialogue tag opens the chapter (¶1), and there are later expansions where the mapping crosses from cosmic mechanics into institutional/Christian-historical reference (notably “churches” and “flesh” in ¶6, and “apostles/commandment” in ¶12). The closing beatitude/exhortation (¶13) reads as later pastoral/application voice rather than impersonal exposition.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.60⟩
[There are] five [releases by] which the light is saved f[rom] all [the rulers and] powers of Darkness!
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed hagiographic/dialogue frame tag: “[Once again] our father [s]peaks:” (late editorial container, not part of the impersonal five-fold teaching).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core content is the impersonal five-fold schema statement; the speech attribution (“our father speaks”) is a compiling-community frame formula.

paragraphs.core_text: [The first loo]sening and saving is that of [the] First Man, since when the First M[a]n was freed fro[m the prison of] the rulers by the Living Spirit, who had come [... ...] of the First Man, much light and [much] power was saved from the entire ruling-power. They ascended with the First Man to the aeons [of] greatn[ess]. This [is the first] release.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Systematic enumerative exposition (“The first…”) and cosmos→cosmos mechanics (First Man, Living Spirit, rulers, aeons) mark substrate teaching.

paragraphs.core_text: The second saving is that of the Liv[ing] Spirit, since whe[n] the Father of Life and [the] Mother of [Li]fe constructed [the ... ...] and [w]orlds [... wo]rlds, the earths and their [rulers; im]measurable light was saved f[r]om them [... the First] Man, who w[a]s devoured [...] lig[ht ...
paragraphs.temporal_note: Impersonal process-description within the cosmic architecture (Father of Life/Mother of Life constructing worlds/earths/rulers; light extracted) indicates the old teaching layer despite lacunae.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.61⟩
... ... th]ree wars [... ...] to the time when he [... ...] above [...] them upon the [... ...] universe.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fragmentary continuation of cosmological war/ascension narrative; no institutional anchoring or citation formula appears.

paragraphs.core_text: [The third red]emption is that of the Thi[rd Ambassador ... he] displayed [his image ...] he [... ... the r]uling-power; he [... ... ... ...] from them [... ...] So this is [how] the [...] his image that [...] in the Th[ir]d Ambassador.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumerative third item; correspondential-cosmic mechanism (image-display before ruling-power) stays internal to the system.

paragraphs.core_text: [Th]e fourth s[av]ing is that of Jesus the Splendour, since whe[n he was] re[ve]aled in the zone he displayed [his im]age in front of the firmaments and purified [the light] that is above. He set in order [t]he earths and all the fastenings. He also loosen[ed ...] light without measure in the entire structure. He gave [the] summons and the obedience to the elements, he formed [J]esus the Youth. He as[ce]n[d]ed and rested himself in the light [land].
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed later application/overlay material that crosses from cosmic mechanics into ecclesial/Christian-historical register: “He established the first righteous o[ne ...] all the churches. He took the likeness [...] he made himself like the angels in [...] un[til] he travelled and descended to the form of flesh.”
paragraphs.temporal_note: Jesus the Splendour as a cosmic revealer/purifier is consistent with substrate cosmology; the abrupt pivot to “churches” and descent “to the form of flesh” signals later Christian/institutional expansion grafted into the enumerative sequence.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth release and saving is that of the great counsel, w[hich is the s]umm[ons an]d the obedience, since it also [...] the soul from the [land] of greatness.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Completes the five-fold list in impersonal definitional style; content remains within Manichaean cosmic soteriology (counsel/summons-and-obedience as a cosmic power).

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.62⟩
[...] the Living Spirit [...] as he gave [...] the release [... ...]
The first [... ... he] ascended and he [... ...] as he [... ...] wisdom [... ...]
The fourth [... ...] its wisdom [...]
And also, the fifth [... ...] into it, and it sets it in order [...] its light image in this Last Statue.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Tabular/iterative recap of releases and their operations, ending with the Last Statue—cosmic eschatological machinery rather than exhortation.

paragraphs.core_text: These five grea[t] powe[rs ...] were revealed. They came to a profit [... ...] they were established upon [... ...] First Man [...] when he came to/ward [...] from the struggle. He set in order and constructed [...] universe [... ...] the First M[an ...] his advent.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Summative cosmological recap; flagged by application-voice scoring but the extant wording remains third-person and internal to the cosmic narrative (no audience-address or institutional targets). Uncertain due to lacunae.
Too fragmentary to date securely; retained as core by default because it reads like a connective within the cosmological sequence and lacks institutional/citation markers.

paragraphs.core_text:
⟨p.63⟩
... because of the light [th]at had rushed from [... ...] the Amba[s]sa[d]or.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic causation statement tied to the (Third) Ambassador; no late frame/pastoral cues are visible.

paragraphs.core_text: The counse[l] of life, which is the [s]ummons and the obedience, will make [... ...] In this last season they [... the] life of the S[t]at[ue and] he judges the sou[ls ... he] can send [... ...] powers, they [...] from the [... ...] it is alive [...] of the will [of the ...] Father, the establ[ished one ...] powerful; they g[o ...] enemy, they [...] all of them [...] conquer this land that they have [... ...] in it for ever [... ... t]hey came fr[om h]im in the beginning, as t[hey will r]eturn again to the light. They [as]cend to him at the la[st].
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed institutional marker tying the cosmic “counsel” to church authority structures: “seal the commandment and the [...] of all [the] apostles.” (The term “apostles” is a later compilation/community register, not substrate cosmology.)
paragraphs.temporal_note: Underlying material concerns eschatological operation of the Summons-and-Obedience/Last Statue/judgment/return-to-light (cosmos→cosmos), but an ecclesial insertion (“apostles/commandment”) anchors it to institutional authority, indicating a mixed transmission layer.
Beatitude/exhortation (“Blessed is every person…”) functions as audience-directed piety/application rather than impersonal cosmological mapping.
